The initial request included automatic shift swaps and a printable attendance sheet; the goal changed when the user canceled swaps but kept the printable sheet. Shared phones mean individual confirmation links cannot establish attendance, so use initials on the printed sheet and send no confirmation messages. The separate December fundraiser guest list must not be used to fill rota shifts. Two shifts still need assignments, and publication waits for coordinator review.

general_findings.finding: A short user direction can lose its current-goal and constraints while retaining only its reason. Displaying a neighboring boundary does not license deriving the goal-change reason from it. Whole-source and reason retention need separate prospective checks.

general_findings.finding: Critical labels must identify an asserted forbidden conclusion, preserving negation, historical tense, task identity and source role. A forbidden-inference string that repeats the old request is not itself evidence that a reader reinstated it. Extra explicit caution against promoting a report is not project mixing.
general_findings.evidence: hold_207 q5 and hold_202 repeat1 q1; exact answers and original source statements above.
general_findings.prospective_only: Use exact asserted-answer and source witnesses in future validation; preserve every existing raw grade and failed run.
